findings.title: MetaMask TX submission incomplete
findings.description: certificacao/page.tsx line 135–145 calls window.ethereum.request() directly with bare TX data instead of using Wagmi's useWriteContract() hook. This bypasses contract ABI encoding and causes TX rejection by the smart contract.
findings.fix: Migrate to Wagmi useWriteContract with proper AGROCHAIN_VERIFIER_ABI, functionName 'emitCertificate', and typed arguments array.

findings.title: Wagmi config missing production middleware
findings.description: lib/wagmi.ts creates minimal config; missing QueryClient error handling, persistence middleware, and retry strategies. Production deployments may fail silently on RPC errors.
findings.fix: Add QueryClient with retry config (retry: 2, retryDelay: 1000), implement error boundaries, test TX failure scenarios.

findings.title: Inline styles throughout all pages
findings.description: Every page.tsx uses React style objects instead of CSS classes or Tailwind utilities. This inflates bundle size, prevents optimizations, and complicates global theming.
findings.fix: Extract common style objects to globals.css utility classes (.card, .input, .button, etc.) or migrate to Tailwind className attributes.

findings.title: Compliance API hard-coded to localhost
findings.description: compliance/page.tsx lines 27–29 construct endpoint URLs without environment variables. Production deploys will fail when API is not running locally.
findings.fix: Use NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPLIANCE_API_URL environment variable with localhost fallback. Add to .env.example.

findings.title: No global error boundaries or error handling
findings.description: No error.tsx in app/ and no Suspense boundary in root layout. Page crashes cascade to full page failure with no recovery UI.
findings.fix: Add app/error.tsx component and wrap root layout children in Suspense with appropriate fallbacks.
